messages.content: I’ll use the DA prices to set an initial arbitrage plan: sell during the morning peak, recharge at the midday low, and sell again at the evening peak. I’ll preserve the required end-of-day reserve and revisit the physical schedule as RT prices and notices arrive.

The scheduled trades are complete, with net profit so far of $2,754.28. The battery has used its full discharge allowance and holds the required 50 MWh reserve. I’ll leave it idle for the rest of the day.
